verses.text: For the music director. A psalm of David. LORD, the king is glad because of your strength. How great is his joy because you gave him victory!
You have given him what his heart wanted. You have not refused what he asked for. Selah.
You came to meet him with rich blessings. You put a crown of pure gold on his head.
He asked you for life, and you gave it to him, a long life that goes on forever and ever.
Because you gave him victory, his glory is great. You have given him honour and majesty.
You have given him blessings that last forever. You have filled him with the joy of being with you.
The king trusts in the LORD. Because of the faithful love of the Most High, nothing will shake him.
Your hand will find all your enemies. Your right hand will find those who hate you.
When you appear, you will burn them up like a fiery furnace. The LORD will swallow them up in his anger. Fire will burn them up.
You will wipe their children off the earth, their descendants from among all people.
They planned evil against you and made evil plans, but they cannot succeed.
You will make them turn and run when you aim your arrows at their faces.
LORD, be honoured in your strength. We will sing and praise your power.
